decision.explanation: Both 'Simona Halep' (supported by D1S1) and 'Angelique Kerber' (supported by D2S1) are presented as winners of the 2019 Wimbledon women's singles title in their respective documents. Since these are distinct referents and both are explicitly stated in separate documents, they are treated as valid and complementary answers. There is no resolution of contradiction provided in the input, so both are preserved.
